title: Include the Sugar Code's terms in cane supply contracts
what: A cane supply contract between a grower and a mill owner must include the terms the Sugar Code lists, such as the cane payment and a related sugar pricing term.

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Code—Sugar) Regulations 2017
sources.quote: 10 Terms of supply contract about sale of on-supply sugar (1) A supply contract for cane between a grower and a mill owner must include each of the following: (a) a term providing for the amount, or the basis for working out the amount, of the payment to the grower for the supply of the cane (the cane payment);
